hero.body: Request technical, safety, quality, COA, origin and supplier-qualification documentation for the titanium dioxide grade your team is evaluating.
hero.note: Requests are currently handled in English.

gradeSelector.heading: Select a Product Grade
gradeSelector.body: Select the product grade the documents relate to. It will be prefilled on the request form and can be changed before submission.
gradeSelector.validation: Select a product grade to continue.
gradeSelector.assistancePrefix: Not sure which grade to select?

items.heading: Identify Your Review Need
items.body: Choose product evaluation, quality and supplier qualification, or origin review.

items.heading: Select a Product Grade
items.body: Choose the titanium dioxide grade the documents should relate to.

items.heading: Request Documents
items.body: Continue with the grade prefilled, select the document types you need, and submit your request.

reviewScenarios.heading: Supporting Your Review Process
reviewScenarios.intro: Start with the decision your team is preparing to make.

items.heading: Product Evaluation
items.body: Review product data, specifications, safety and handling information for the selected grade.

items.heading: Quality & Supplier Qualification
items.body: Support QA and supplier qualification with quality information, COA-related documentation and supplier details.

items.heading: Origin & Supplier Qualification Review
items.body: Request origin and supplier-qualification information for purchasing and internal review.

documentCategories.heading: Documentation You Can Request
documentCategories.intro: Choose the category that best matches your review.

items.heading: Technical Data & Product Documentation
items.body: Technical product data and specifications for evaluating the selected grade.

items.heading: Safety Documentation
items.body: Safety, handling and storage information for workplace and product review.

items.heading: Quality & COA Documentation
items.body: Quality information and COA-related documentation for QA and purchasing checks.

items.heading: Origin & Supplier Qualification Documentation
items.body: Origin and company documentation for supplier qualification and purchasing review.

whyOnRequest.heading: Why Documents Are Provided on Request
whyOnRequest.body: Documentation can differ by product and review purpose. Submitting a request helps match the materials to the selected grade and the information your team needs. Availability and applicable scope are confirmed during review.

items.question: What documents can I request?
items.answer: You can request technical/product, safety, quality/COA, and origin/supplier-qualification documentation.

items.question: Do I need to know the Product Grade?
items.answer: Yes. Select the Product Grade the documents should relate to. If you are not sure, explore Products before continuing.

items.question: Can I request more than one document type?
items.answer: Yes. On the Request Documents form, you can select the document types your team needs.

items.question: Can I change the prefilled Product Grade?
items.answer: Yes. The selected Product Grade is prefilled on the request form and can be changed before submission.

items.question: Why are documents provided on request?
items.answer: Documentation can differ by product and review purpose. A request helps match the materials to the selected Grade and your team's needs.

items.question: What language is used for document requests?
items.answer: Requests are currently handled in English.

closingCta.heading: Ready to Request Documents?
closingCta.body: Select the product grade the documents relate to. We’ll carry it into the request form, where you can choose the document types you need.
